set.body:
Outcome: one clean, independently reviewed integration candidate reconciles the locally qualified GitHub-source/offline CLI and mapping-audit delivery with main. This is preparation of a concrete candidate; main movement, pushing, publication and consumer default-pin adoption retain their required authority.

Inputs: main 13aec7cc874ed1c2695c6dd281852523cc43ef90; mapping branch37f659277199d9d1922b772f13b0b260b1e028d9, functional sourcea11c79726ea817a23c5e4096ee0b7848aa47b71b; S1 sourcec69a5d754a21fa455c64901334d9509278401091; exact local engineering/review receipts in docs/refactor/mapping-audit-20261020.md and evidence/source-cli-20261015/README.md. S1 and mapping children remain review until actual authorized landing.

Acceptance:
1. Audit every ancestor above current main, including the22pre-existing ancestors below the mapping baseline6702a28ec. Record approved source/CLI, proposed authority/protocol documents and unrelated instrument/Native work separately; no unreviewed or unauthorized ancestor is silently bundled. Preserve both task branches and all dirty/untracked data. Use a standalone clone or verified export.
2. Produce an exact integration candidate with an explicit path/commit allowlist and compatibility inventory. Reuse prior evidence only when its inputs match. Mapping qualification used clean grakern8efc5efade4e56c6e0b29745bd1b108d4c9a9d57 override; the ordinary build selects0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841. Qualify the declared Git source route without overrides; do not claim the override gate proves default installation. Stop on an incompatible/inaccessible pin and record the narrow failing witness before proposing a dependency decision.
3. Gate the actual candidate with reference-scope, CI fatal warnings, every affected platform, final formatting and explicit passed/failed/skipped totals. Rebuild the CLI for these actual source bytes; verify packaged provenance/notices, offline paired/reference-only/weighted exports, legacy/new-version readers, complete failure/coverage accounting, resume/overwrite refusals, and downstream518-test-class Atlas seam on its explicitly recorded producer revision. Historical counts are context, not targets. One heavy gate at a time.
4. Independent exact-commit review verifies code, ancestry, receipts and candidate/consumer/default-pin-versus-override identities. Prepare the final reviewable integration action and authorization boundary; no merge/push or release under this planning task alone. Once authorized landing actually occurs, bind its SHA and exact remote state, then close S1 and mapping siblings only against their own acceptance.

Does not include instrument scientific reruns, E1-E3 execution, authority-model choice, Native fork/publication or a new solver. Next action: compare current branch/main ancestry and receipt input sets, then propose the smallest integration tree. Split if the resulting source repair exceeds a day; retain this bounded integration acceptance.
set.title: [delivery] Prepare exact integration of reviewed source CLI and mapping work
